rubin.linePrev: They told him he could identify the guilty men
rubin.line: Four in the morning and they haul Rubin in
rubin.lineNext: They take him to the hospital and they brought him upstairs
stanza: Four in the morning and they haul Rubin in
They take him to the hospital and they brought him upstairs
The wounded man looks up through his one dying eye
Say, “Why did you bring him in here for? He ain't the guy!”

rubin.linePrev: Are free to drink Martinis, and watch the sun rise
rubin.line: While Rubin sits like Buddha in a ten-foot cell
rubin.lineNext: An innocent man in a living hell
stanza: Now all the criminals in their coats and their ties
Are free to drink Martinis, and watch the sun rise
While Rubin sits like Buddha in a ten-foot cell
An innocent man in a living hell

rubin.lineNext: The crime was murder “one”, guess who testified?
stanza: Rubin Carter was falsely tried
The crime was murder “one”, guess who testified?
Bello and Bradley and they both baldly lied
And the newspapers, they all went along for the ride

rubin.line: Rubin could take a man out with just one punch
rubin.lineNext: But he never did like to talk about it all that much
stanza: Rubin could take a man out with just one punch
But he never did like to talk about it all that much
"It’s my work", he’d say, "and I do it for pay"
"And when it’s over I’d just as soon go on my way"

rubin.linePrev: Meanwhile, far away in another part of town
rubin.line: Rubin Carter and a couple of friends are drivin' around
rubin.lineNext: Number one contender for the middleweight crown
stanza: Meanwhile, far away in another part of town
Rubin Carter and a couple of friends are drivin' around
Number one contender for the middleweight crown
Had no idea what kinda shit was about to go down
